Interface SecpPubKey

All Superinterfaces:
AsymmetricKey, DEREncodablePREVIEW, ECKey, ECPublicKey, Key, PublicKey, SecpPoint, SecpPoint.Point, SecpPoint.Uncompressed, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
SecpPubKeyImpl
public interface SecpPubKey extends ECPublicKey, SecpPoint.Uncompressed
A valid secp256k1 Public Key that is a subclass of ECPublicKey.
